t: The Reveal: Maximal Style in the Marshes
d: In this South Carolina stunner, designer Mary Welch Fox turns up the volume on style with bold choices, fearless edge, and serious design swagger  this home doesn't just bend the rules-it breaks them wide open.

t: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
d: DIYer Rachel Metz heads to the desert to claim her first-ever solo home  Rachel tours her Joshua Tree ranch and begins transforming the fixer-upper into a dream homestead, starting with a custom bed frame built from wood stumps found on her new land.

t: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
d: Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall  when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

t: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
d: Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views  when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

Chef, restaurateur, and author Melba Wilson schools Matthew on the art of her legendary shrimp and grits  with laughter, flavor, and zero room for dessert, this visit is an unforgettable taste of Harlem's finest and most original.

Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers  first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

st: Norman Fenton: The Art of Latin Flavors
d: Matthew travels to Chicago to meet Michelin-starred Chef Norman Fenton at Cariño  Chef Norman makes fresh dough for his signature Huitlacoche Ravioli  at the bar, Raymond crafts a custom Tejuino cocktail featuring Reserva De La Familia Tequila.

st: A Tiny Frame of Mind  Tiny Cabin & Caboose
d: In Ohio, Levi visits Pinnacle A-Frame and The Wren at Hillside Amble  heading to Virginia for a look at James Station Caboose, a nearly 40-foot-long caboose-turned-tiny-home.

Levi heads to Ohio to explore two modern studio cabins  Star Meadow in Logan is a serene sanctuary designed for nature lovers  Levi visits The Everwoods Alpine, a romantic escape that mixes contemporary design with a deep forest feel.

Levi explores the Sunshine State to find unique stays  he starts in Orlando at the Micro House, the state's first 3D-printed micro home  then, he heads to Key Largo to board Stay Ombi, a floating bungalow anchored in Buttonwood Sound.

Levi explores two whimsical retreats plucked straight from a fairytale  he starts in Rising Fawn at the Laurel Zome, a stunning geometric dome  then Levi discovers the Merry Mushroom, a charming tiny home designed to resemble woodland fungi.

t: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich: This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale
d: Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life  with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.
